name: Block Automatic Peripheral Software Installs
description: Blocks automatic Razer driver and software installs to prevent unwanted background services and system clutter.
commands:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Device Installer" /v DisableCoInstallers /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
rmdir /s "C:\Windows\Installer\Razer"
mkdir "C:\Windows\Installer\Razer"
icacls "C:\Windows\Installer\Razer" /deny "SYSTEM:(OI)(CI)W"
revert22H2:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Device Installer" /v DisableCoInstallers /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

icacls "C:\Windows\Installer\Razer" /remove:d SYSTEM
rmdir /s /q "C:\Windows\Installer\Razer"
revert23H2:
